task: vibebelt-rebrand Phase 6: rename the vc- prefix to vb- (one tool, one rename commit) and build upgrade safety
riskClasses: schema/data migration or destructive data mutation
public API or external contract changes
why: One script rewrites 272 files and renames 104 paths in a single commit. The installer and updater (install.sh, compute-sync-plan.mjs) gain a deletion path that removes old vc- kit files from user projects. Public names change: agents, skills, the four uppercase signals, VC_ env variables, the manifest and state-file names.
approver: user: standing ENTER EXECUTE MODE consent for the program (accepted CONDITIONAL inner PVL); restart checkpoint after the rename commit; EVL by an independent vb-tester in the restarted session
controls: rename tool refuses a dirty tree, never follows symlinks, never writes outside --root, stops before writing on any keep-region or collision error
tool, fixtures, fallbacks and allowlists committed BEFORE the apply; rollback SHA in harness/pre-vb-rename.sha (no tag)
legacy gate deletes an old kit file only when its sha256 equals legacy-hashes.json, or when every file of a snapshot-gated entry is in the old install snapshot; everything else is kept and reported
no push, no remote, no tag, no git reset --hard; pre-commit crash recovery uses the plan's fail-closed recovery block
